egress.terms: Free, unmetered hotlinking, CDN-served, no published bandwidth tier. Only soft pressure: if you use 'a really large amount' of disk/bandwidth without linking back they reserve the right to contact you.

tooling: Documented token API — their own upload endpoint says 'Please use the official API: https://api.postimages.org/'. ShareX ships a Postimages destination keyed on an account API key from the profile page; npm 'postimages-upload'.
chaining: Unlimited free accounts, each with unlimited images. Gallery per account, 1,000 images per batch (batch size, not a cap).
limits_note: 32 MB/file and 10,000x10,000 px for free and anonymous; Premium 96 MB / 65,535 px. EXIF preserved by default (evidence of no re-encode). Programmatic upload only via the token API, not the web endpoint.
